description: Discovers the URLs of a public site (up to 200), optionally ranked by a search term. Returns { url, count, links }: up to 200 unique public URLs. Price: 6 credits (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

includeSubdomains.description: Also include links on subdomains of the site.

search.description: Optional term to rank and filter links by, up to 200 characters.

url.description: Public http(s) URL. Private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses, internal hostnames and this service's own hosts are refused.

name: web-map
title: Site map
